decisive_spans.text: CT scan findings:  Image Title: Axial CT scans  Image Description: Extensive macular alveolar infiltrations throughout both lungs, showing both apical and basal infiltrations

response.rationale: The patient was buried under snow and presented with hypoxemic respiratory failure and bilateral infiltrations on CT scan, which is consistent with hypothermia-induced injury. This makes D7 a strong candidate. D6 is also a strong candidate as the patient had acute onset of hypoxemic respiratory failure with bilateral infiltrations on CT scan and no evidence of trauma. However, the specific context of being buried under snow points more directly to D7.
